title: DESQ: Dynamic Ensemble Selection for Quantitative Stock Selection (v1.0-desq)
description: Reference implementation and reviewer reproducibility kit for the DES-based quantitative stock-selection pipeline described in the IEEE Access submission. This v1.0-desq snapshot ships SHA-256 fingerprints of the Taiwan-50 features, a yfinance cross-check for the 2330 canary prices, a 3-stage smoke pipeline (Stage-1 CUSUM + Stage-2 ATT/D-flood + Stage-3 DES), and a GitHub Actions workflow that re-runs the falsifiable checks on every push.
